thread:
Marta Nguyen: Quick kickoff for Kitewave onboarding — want to lock stakeholders, success criteria, and a 0–30 day plan. Can we meet Wed 3/20 11:00am PT? Agenda: 1) stakeholders & owners, 2) success criteria / acceptance, 3) 0–30 timeline + owners, 4) risks & blockers. Pinged folks below.

Devin Park: Wed 11 works for me. Quick Q: will Kitewave be on Private (VPC) or Hosted? Need that to size Dedicated capacity.

Alex Li (Kitewave): We want Private (VPC). SOC2 in scope — data needs to stay in our VPC. Also FYI we'll ingest ~20k docs initially, then ~5k/day.

Samira Ortiz: Great — I can lead enablement. I'll prep a pre-kick checklist and a 90-min workshop for data onboarding. Do we have a preferred SSO method (SAML/OIDC)?

Alex Li (Kitewave): SAML via Okta. I'll share admin contact.

Devin Park: Noted. For Private + SAML we'll need a short network checklist and the service account + firewall egress rules. Samira, can you add that to the pre-kick?

Samira Ortiz: Yep — will add a "network & SSO pre-reqs" section. Also adding a recommended staging hitlist: sample data schema, sample convo prompts, and success evals.

Marta Nguyen: Owner map (draft):
- Stakeholder (Kitewave exec): Alex Li (product)
- Technical owner (Kitewave infra): TBA (Alex will confirm)
- CSM (Redwood): Marta Nguyen -> overall cadence & renewal signal
- Solutions lead (Redwood): Samira Ortiz -> enablement, workshop
- Infra lead (Redwood): Devin Park -> Private deployment + capacity

Marta Nguyen: Proposed success criteria (please edit):
- Inference endpoint accessible from Kitewave VPC and passes auth (SAML)
- Data pipeline ingests first 20k docs and indexing completes within 48h
- Latency < 250ms p95 on 1k concurrent requests in staging
- Demo flow with product team showing saved prompts and reranking

Alex Li (Kitewave): Those look good. Add one more: initial user satisfaction score >= 4/5 from pilot group (10 users) after week 2.

Marta Nguyen: Done — adding that.

Devin Park: On capacity — we should reserve a small Dedicated pool for first 30 days and enable burst to Hosted if needed. I'll propose numbers in the doc after I see sample QPS.

Samira Ortiz: I'll publish the pre-kick checklist and a short runbook. Link to draft playbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/playbooks/kitewave-onboard-draft (working doc)

Alex Li (Kitewave): Sharing Okta admin: okta-admin@kitewave.com. Also will upload a 5000-sample-docs dump by Mon EOD.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Kitewave Onboarding Kickoff" Wed Mar 20 11:00am PT — invite sent to Alex, Marta, Devin, Samira. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/kw-onboard-0319

Marta Nguyen: Quick blockers to track now:
- SOC2 review / privacy checklist (Alex to confirm any special clauses)
- Network allowlist handed to Devin by Mon 3/18
- Data sample delivery (Alex) by Mon EOD — needed for staging tests

Alex Li (Kitewave): I'll confirm any SOC2 exceptions by EOD Monday.

Devin Park: Can someone add PKCE client id details for SAML testing? I will need test creds in staging by Tue.

Samira Ortiz: Adding that to pre-kick tasks: "Provide test SAML metadata + staging service account".

Marta Nguyen: I'll send a short 0–30 roadmap in this thread by EOD today with owner dates. For now: Week0 = access + staging deploy; Week1 = data ingest + basic evals; Week2 = enablement workshop + pilot; Week3–4 = regression checks + go-live prep.

Alex Li (Kitewave): Sounds good. Thanks all — see you Wed. :thumbsup:

Devin Park: Thanks — prepping capacity notes and firewall snippet:
```
# Firewall egress
allow tcp 443 -> 10.8.0.0/16 (redwood-hosting)
allow tcp 5222 -> 10.8.0.5 (controlplane)
```

Samira Ortiz: I also threw together a short eval checklist (QA + UX): 1) end-to-end prompt test, 2) rerank sanity, 3) embeddings/semantic search smoke, 4) cost baseline. Will attach before the meeting.

Marta Nguyen: Perfect. Last note: Renewal signal — we'll treat initial 30–90 day product engagement + pilot satisfaction as the primary leading indicator. If anything looks off, flag it in this channel and we'll escalate.

Alex Li (Kitewave): Will do. Appreciate the crisp plan.

Devin Park: :rocket:

calendar-bot: Reminder set for 30m before meeting.
